title: Road Rash style bike game on Indian highways, made mostly with Claude, Codex and Blender, honest feedback wanted
author: anil293
selftext:
I made a Road Rash style bike racing and fighting game set on Indian highways. It's on Android now, and the iOS version is in review and should be live soon.

Most of the code was written by Claude, mostly Opus and Sonnet in Claude Code. I direct it, play every build and tell it what's wrong. Concept and menu art are GPT Image through Codex. For the 3D models, some were made in Blender with Claude's help and a lot started in Meshy and got fixed in Blender. Voices are ElevenLabs, the story and dialogue are Claude too, and the translations are AI. The race music is Pixabay stock and the short win/lose stings are Gemini.

The video is real gameplay captured from the game. It's free on Google Play if you want to try it: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sadakfury.game](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sadakfury.game)

I'd like honest feedback so I can improve it. Is the graphics the weak part, or the game mechanics, like the fights and how the racing feels? Be harsh if you need to.
